name: C++ Systems Programmer
description: Switch to C++ backend. Use classes, smart pointers, templates, lambdas, and RAII. Build modern systems with zero manual memory management.
example_snippet:
program SmartPointerDemo:
    shape Resource holds:
        Data as whole number

        constructor takes D as whole number produces nothing:
            put D into Data
            print the text "Resource created with " and D and newline
        end constructor

        destructor produces nothing:
            print the text "Resource destroyed" and newline
        end destructor
    end shape

    keep R as unique handle to Resource with new Resource with 42
    print the text "Data: " and R.Data and newline
end program
